titleZh: 英國外交部因間諜案召見中國大使
titleEn: UK Foreign Office Summons Chinese Ambassador Over Espionage Case
summary: 英國外交部因一起間諜案件召見中國駐英大使。文章標題直接指向英中之間的外交抗議與情報爭議。
summaryZh: 英國外交部因一起間諜案件召見中國駐英大使。文章重點在英中外交摩擦與間諜爭議。
summaryEn: The UK Foreign Office summoned China’s ambassador over an espionage case. The article centers on a diplomatic dispute between the UK and China.

titleZh: 北約擬拉日本參與太空計畫
titleEn: NATO Seeks to Bring Japan Into Space Project
summary: 文章標題指稱北約希望邀請日本參與一項太空計畫。正文主要是俄文新聞彙編，夾雜多則與俄羅斯、歐洲及其他議題相關的短訊，其中最相關的是北約與日本的合作意向。
summaryZh: 文章標題稱北約希望邀請日本參與太空計畫。內文以多則俄文新聞摘要為主，但與本題最直接相關的是北約對日本的合作提議。
summaryEn: The headline says NATO wants to involve Japan in a space project. The body is largely a roundup of unrelated Russian news items, but the core East Asia-relevant item is NATO's outreach to Japan.

titleZh: 中國東航MU5735空難再現新線索：燃油開關疑遭切斷
titleEn: New Clue Emerges in China Eastern MU5735 Crash as Fuel Switches Were Cut Off
summary: 文章談及中國東方航空MU5735空難的新線索：美國NTSB公開資料顯示，兩具引擎的燃油開關被切到「cut-off」位置，可能導致失去推力並墜毀。文中也提到中國官方至今未發布最終報告，並回顧外界對是否為蓄意行為的長期猜測。
summaryZh: 文章指出，美國NTSB最新公開資料顯示，中國東航MU5735航班兩具引擎的燃油開關被切至「cut-off」位置，可能是失事關鍵。報導同時提到，中國官方尚未公布最終調查報告，外界也持續質疑是否存在蓄意因素。
summaryEn: The article says newly released NTSB data indicate both engine fuel switches on China Eastern Flight MU5735 were moved to cut-off, possibly causing the crash. It also notes that China has not issued a final report and that speculation about intentional action has persisted.

titleZh: 中國與歐洲間貨運列車班列數量突破13萬列
titleEn: China-Europe freight train services exceed 130,000 runs
summary: 報導指出，中國與歐洲之間往來的貨運列車班列數量已突破13萬列，反映跨境鐵路物流與貿易運輸持續成長。
summaryZh: 報導指出，中國與歐洲之間往來的貨運列車班列數量已突破13萬列，顯示跨境鐵路物流與貿易運輸規模持續擴大。
summaryEn: The article says the number of freight train services operating between China and Europe has surpassed 130,000, indicating continued growth in cross-border rail logistics and trade transport.

titleZh: 烏克蘭冰球隊19年後重返頂級賽事　澤連斯基祝賀
titleEn: Ukraine’s hockey team returns to the elite after 19 years, with Zelensky congratulating them
summary: Az ukrán jégkorong-válogatott 19 év után visszajutott az elitbe, miután a divízió I/A világbajnokságon második lett. A cikk a csapat hosszú visszaesését, 2024-es felemelkedését és Zelenszkij gratulációját hangsúlyozza, valamint azt, hogy a siker háborús időkben nemzeti szimbólummá vált.
summaryZh: 烏克蘭冰球代表隊在分級賽奪得第二名，19年後重返世界頂級賽事。文章回顧球隊長期低潮與2024年的復甦，並提到澤連斯基將這項勝利視為戰火中的象徵性鼓舞。
summaryEn: Ukraine’s ice hockey team finished second in the Division I/A world championship and returned to the elite after 19 years. The article reviews the team’s long decline and 2024 revival, and says Zelensky praised the result as a symbolic boost during wartime.

titleZh: 中國重慶小寨天坑：世界最深喀斯特巨坑的地質與生態奧秘
titleEn: Xiaozhai Tiankeng in Chongqing, China: The Geology and Ecology of a Giant Karst Sinkhole
summary: 文章介紹中國重慶的 Xiaozhai Tiankeng 天坑，強調其作為世界最深、最大的喀斯特天坑之一，內部擁有與世隔絕的亞熱帶森林、特殊微氣候與豐富生態，也提到其地質形成過程與尚未充分探勘的洞穴系統。
summaryZh: 文章介紹中國重慶的 Xiaozhai Tiankeng 天坑，強調其作為世界最深、最大的喀斯特天坑之一，內部擁有與世隔絕的亞熱帶森林、特殊微氣候與豐富生態，也提到其地質形成過程與尚未充分探勘的洞穴系統。
summaryEn: The article examines Xiaozhai Tiankeng in Chongqing, China, describing it as one of the world’s deepest and largest karst sinkholes. It highlights the isolated subtropical forest, unique microclimate, geological formation, and the still largely unexplored cave network beneath the sinkhole.

titleZh: 伊朗外長訪問北京
titleEn: Iranian Foreign Minister Visits Beijing
summary: 这篇文章仅明确提到伊朗外长访问北京，属于发生在中国的外交行程，但正文未提供更多关于会谈内容或东亚其他国家的实质信息。
summaryZh: 這篇文章僅明確提到伊朗外長訪問北京，屬於發生在中國的外交行程，但正文未提供更多會談內容或東亞其他國家的實質資訊。
summaryEn: The article only states that Iran’s foreign minister visited Beijing, indicating a China-based diplomatic trip, with no substantive details on talks or any broader East Asian implications.

titleZh: 中國與烏茲別克斯坦擬深化能源與資源合作
titleEn: China and Uzbekistan plan to deepen cooperation on energy and resources
summary: 文章標題指出，中國與烏茲別克斯坦計畫深化在能源與資源領域的合作，核心聚焦雙邊經貿與資源協作。
summaryZh: 文章標題指出，中國與烏茲別克斯坦計畫深化在能源與資源領域的合作，重點在雙邊資源開發與能源協作。
summaryEn: The article states that China and Uzbekistan plan to deepen cooperation in energy and resources, focusing on bilateral resource development and energy collaboration.

titleZh: 中國「命運共同體」對東南亞的外交布局與挑戰
titleEn: China’s “Community of Shared Future” in Southeast Asia and Its Limits
summary: 文章分析中國提出的「人類命運共同體」如何延伸到東南亞，並以一帶一路、疫苗外交、數位化與氣候合作塑造對東協的區域敘事。但南海爭議、經濟依賴與大國競爭削弱了其可信度，未來需更尊重東協中心性與多邊架構。
summaryZh: 文章討論中國將「命運共同體」擴展到東南亞的外交敘事，透過基建、疫苗外交與區域合作強化影響力，但南海爭端、經濟不對稱與中美競爭使這一願景面臨信任與主權疑慮。
summaryEn: The article examines how China extends its “Community of Shared Future” narrative to Southeast Asia through infrastructure, vaccine diplomacy, and regional cooperation. It argues that South China Sea disputes, economic asymmetry, and US-China rivalry undermine trust and limit the vision’s reach.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯手球隊將赴中國甘州參加國際賽
titleEn: Belarus Handball Team to Compete in International Tournament in China's Ganzhou
summary: 白俄羅斯男子手球國家隊下週將赴中國甘州參加國際賽，並在北京轉赴賽地。球隊將先後對陣中國國家隊、中國青年隊、俄羅斯隊及香港隊。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯男子手球國家隊下週將前往中國甘州參加國際邀請賽，先在北京集合後轉赴賽地。賽程包括對中國國家隊、中國青年隊、俄羅斯隊及香港隊的比賽。
summaryEn: Belarus's men's national handball team will travel to Ganzhou, China, next week for an international tournament. After gathering in Minsk and transiting through Beijing, they will face China, China's youth team, Russia, and Hong Kong.

titleZh: Opel將與中國製造商合作打造新車
titleEn: Opel to build a car together with a Chinese manufacturer
summary: 這篇文章的標題指出，Opel將與中國製造商共同打造一款汽車。內文本身主要是報社固定導流與介紹文字，沒有提供更多細節。
summaryZh: 文章標題指出，Opel將與中國製造商合作開發並生產一款新車；內文主要是媒體固定介紹與導流文字，未提供更多細節。
summaryEn: The headline says Opel will make a car together with a Chinese manufacturer. The body contains only the outlet’s standard promotional boilerplate and no further details.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙火工廠爆炸死亡增至37人
titleEn: Death Toll Rises to 37 in Fireworks Plant Blast in Hunan, China
summary: 中國湖南瀏陽一座煙火工廠5月4日發生爆炸，死亡人數增至37人，另有1人失蹤、51人受傷。搜救工作已大致完成，中國國家主席習近平要求加強全國生產場所安全管理並追究責任。
summaryZh: 中國湖南瀏陽一座煙火工廠5月4日發生爆炸，死亡人數增至37人，另有1人失蹤、51人受傷。搜救工作已大致完成，習近平要求加強全國工業安全並追究責任。
summaryEn: A fireworks factory explosion in Liuyang, Hunan Province, China, on May 4 has killed 37 people, left one missing, and injured 51. Search and rescue is mostly complete, and Xi Jinping has called for tighter safety oversight and accountability.

titleZh: 中國公開外銷版J-35AE 料已簽下首筆出口合約
titleEn: China Reveals Export J-35AE, Signaling First Likely Sales Deal
summary: Kineski državni mediji objavili su snimak izvozne verzije lovca pete generacije J-35AE, što analitičari tumače kao znak da je verovatno potpisan prvi ugovor o prodaji. Članak naglašava da Kina pojačava napore da ovaj avion plasira na strana tržišta.
summaryZh: 中國官媒公開展示首款外銷配置的第五代戰機 J-35AE，分析人士認為這很可能意味著首筆出口合約已經簽署。文章指出，這顯示中國正積極推動該型戰機進軍海外市場。
summaryEn: Chinese state media aired footage of the first export-configured J-35AE stealth fighter, which analysts say likely indicates the first sales contract has been signed. The article frames this as part of China's push to market the aircraft overseas.

titleZh: 美媒稱若特朗普訪中後仍無美伊協議　戰爭選項恐再度浮上檯面
titleEn: Israeli Media: If No Deal After Trump’s China Visit, War Option Returns
summary: 文章稱，美國與伊朗若在特朗普訪問中國前未能達成結束衝突的協議，軍事選項可能重新被提上桌面。白宮預計很快收到伊朗對美方新提案的回應，而特朗普計劃於5月14日至15日訪中。
summaryZh: 文章稱，美國與伊朗若在特朗普訪問中國前未能達成結束衝突的協議，軍事選項可能重新被提上桌面。白宮預計很快收到伊朗對美方新提案的回應，而特朗普計劃於5月14日至15日訪中。
summaryEn: The article says that if the U.S. and Iran do not reach a deal before President Trump returns from his planned visit to China, the military option could come back onto the table. The White House expects Iran’s response soon, and Trump is scheduled to visit China on May 14-15.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯與中國宣布旗艦級科技合作專案競賽
titleEn: Belarus and China announce flagship science and technology project contests
summary: 白俄羅斯與中國啟動2027至2030年旗艦級科技專案與2027至2029年科技專案徵集，涵蓋智慧製造、新材料、AI、數位經濟、醫療與航太等領域，預計選出最多10個大型合作項目。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學技術委員會與中國科技部啟動兩項聯合徵集，面向2027至2030年及2027至2029年合作科技項目，涵蓋製造、新材料、AI、數位經濟、醫療與航太等方向。
summaryEn: Belarus and China have launched two joint calls for science and technology projects covering 2027-2030 and 2027-2029. The programs span smart manufacturing, new materials, AI, digital economy, biomedicine and aerospace, with up to 10 major flagship projects to be selected.

titleZh: 中國因貪腐判處兩名前國防部長死緩
titleEn: China Hands Down Suspended Death Sentences to Two Former Defense Ministers for Corruption
summary: 中國軍事法庭以貪腐罪名判處前國防部長魏鳳和與李尚福死緩，兩人同時被褫奪終身政治權利，個人財產也將被沒收。法院指出，兩人的死刑在兩年緩期後可依法減為無期徒刑。
summaryZh: 中國軍事法庭以貪腐罪名判處前國防部長魏鳳和與李尚福死緩，並褫奪終身政治權利、沒收財產。法院稱，兩人刑期在兩年緩期後可依法減為無期徒刑。
summaryEn: A Chinese military court sentenced former defense ministers Wei Fenghe and Li Shangfu to suspended death sentences for corruption. Both were stripped of political rights for life and had their personal assets confiscated; the sentence can be commuted to life imprisonment after two years.

titleZh: 伊朗否認捲入荷姆茲海峽韓國貨船事故
titleEn: Iran Denies Involvement in Incident Involving South Korean Ship in the Strait of Hormuz
summary: 伊朗否認與荷姆茲海峽一艘由韓國 HMM 公司營運、懸掛巴拿馬旗的貨船起火爆炸事件有關。韓國方面表示，事故原因需待船隻拖回港口並詳細檢查後才能確定，調查仍在進行中。
summaryZh: 伊朗駐首爾大使館否認伊朗軍方與一艘在荷姆茲海峽受損的韓國船隻有關，並稱安全通過該海域需遵守伊朗規定。韓國方面表示，事故原因仍待拖回港口後檢查確認。
summaryEn: Iran’s embassy in Seoul denied any involvement by Iranian forces in the damage to a South Korean-operated ship in the Strait of Hormuz. South Korean authorities said the cause of the fire and explosion will be confirmed only after the vessel is towed to port and inspected.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學院與中國企業探討創新合作前景
titleEn: Belarus Academy of Sciences and Chinese Firms Explore Innovation Cooperation
summary: 白俄羅斯國家科學院與中國企業代表會面，討論在創新與高科技領域的合作前景。雙方聚焦機械製造、無人運輸、機器人、雷射、光學與ICT等方向，強調合作需有明確規劃與機制。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學院與中國企業代表討論創新合作，重點涵蓋機械製造、無人運輸、機器人、雷射、光學與ICT等高科技領域，並強調雙方合作需要明確規劃與機制。
summaryEn: Belarus’ National Academy of Sciences met with Chinese business representatives to discuss innovation cooperation. The talks focused on high-tech areas including machinery, unmanned transport, robotics, laser technology, optics and ICT, with an emphasis on clear cooperation mechanisms.

titleZh: 南韓首度為人形機器人舉行佛教受戒儀式
titleEn: South Korea Holds First Buddhist Ordination Ceremony for a Humanoid Robot
summary: 南韓首爾曹溪宗寺院首次讓人形機器人參與佛教受戒儀式，並為其取名「Gabi」。機器人依規完成禮拜、回答發願問題，未來還將參加佛誕燈節活動。
summaryZh: 南韓首爾曹溪宗寺院首次讓人形機器人參與佛教受戒儀式，並取名「Gabi」。儀式中機器人以適應其特性的方式接受五戒，未來還將參加佛誕燈節。
summaryEn: A Buddhist temple of the Jogye Order in Seoul held what Yonhap described as South Korea's first vow-taking ceremony for a humanoid robot. The robot, named Gabi, was given adapted precepts and is expected to join a Buddha's Birthday lantern festival.

titleZh: 中國表示願協助促成伊朗與美國和談
titleEn: China Says It Is Ready to Help Launch Iran-US Peace Talks
summary: Kina je u Pekingu poručila da je spremna da pomogne pokretanje mirovnih pregovora između Irana i SAD, uz apel za prekid vatre i stabilizaciju situacije na Bliskom istoku. Teheran je Kinu opisao kao bliskog prijatelja i najavio jačanje saradnje.
summaryZh: 中國在北京表示，願意協助推動伊朗與美國之間的和平談判，並呼籲停火以緩和中東緊張局勢。伊朗則稱中國是親密友邦，並表示雙邊合作將進一步加強。
summaryEn: China said in Beijing that it is ready to help launch peace talks between Iran and the United States and called for a ceasefire to ease Middle East tensions. Iran described China as a close friend and said bilateral cooperation will strengthen further.

titleZh: 白俄羅斯 BELINTERTRANS 擴大對華出口物流能力
titleEn: Belarusian BELINTERTRANS Expands Logistics Capacity for Exports to China
summary: 白俄羅斯國營企業「BELINTERTRANS」正在擴大面向中國的物流能力，以支持白俄羅斯對華出口。文章重點是貿易運輸與供應鏈安排。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國營企業「BELINTERTRANS」正在擴大面向中國的物流能力，以支持白俄羅斯對華出口。文章重點是貿易運輸與供應鏈安排。
summaryEn: Belarusian state enterprise BELINTERTRANS is expanding logistics capacity for Belarusian exports to China, focusing on trade transport and supply-chain support.

titleZh: 中國外長王毅在北京會見伊朗外長阿拉格齊
titleEn: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi Meets Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi in Beijing
summary: 中國外長王毅在北京會見伊朗外長阿巴斯·阿拉格齊，雙方討論中伊合作及伊朗與美國的談判。報道指出，會談背景與霍爾木茲海峽緊張局勢有關，也反映北京在中東外交中的位置。
summaryZh: 中國外長王毅6日在北京與伊朗外長阿巴斯·阿拉格齊會談，討論雙邊合作及伊朗與美國的談判進展。文章稱，此行發生在霍爾木茲海峽緊張升高之際，也凸顯北京在相關外交斡旋中的角色。
summaryEn: China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi met Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Beijing on May 6 to discuss bilateral cooperation and Iran's talks with the United States. The meeting came amid rising tensions over the Strait of Hormuz and highlighted Beijing's diplomatic role.

titleZh: 上海將興建全球最高無輻條摩天輪
titleEn: Shanghai to Build the World’s Tallest Spokeless Ferris Wheel
summary: 上海北部寶山區將興建一座高 228 公尺的無輻條摩天輪「上海之弧」，預計成為全球最高同類設施。工程將於 2026 年底動工，總投資約 2 億人民幣。
summaryZh: 上海北部寶山區將興建高 228 公尺的無輻條摩天輪「上海之弧」，預計成為全球最高同類設施。工程將於 2026 年底動工，投資估計為 2 億人民幣。
summaryEn: Shanghai’s Baoshan district will build a 228-meter spokeless Ferris wheel called the “Shanghai Arc,” which is set to become the world’s tallest of its kind. Construction is scheduled to begin in late 2026, with an estimated cost of 200 million yuan.

titleZh: 日本校車發生交通事故　釀1死
titleEn: School bus crash in Japan leaves one dead
summary: 在日本發生一起校車交通事故，造成一人死亡。文章標題與正文均只提到日本校車出車禍及有死者，沒有更多細節。
summaryZh: 在日本發生一起校車交通事故，造成一人死亡。文章僅提供事故標題資訊，未說明具體時間、地點或更多傷亡細節。
summaryEn: A school bus in Japan was involved in a traffic accident that left one person dead. The article provides only the basic headline-level facts and no further details on location or circumstances.

titleZh: 明斯克植物園櫻花綻放　文章談日本櫻花文化
titleEn: Sakura Blooms at Minsk Botanical Garden, Highlighting Japanese Cultural Symbolism
summary: 明斯克中央植物園的櫻花綻放，文章同時介紹櫻花在日本文化中的象徵意義與相關趣聞，並邀請民眾前往賞花。
summaryZh: 白俄羅斯國家科學院中央植物園的櫻花近日開花。報導介紹櫻花在日本文化中的象徵與涵義，並指出花期通常不超過一週。
summaryEn: Sakura has bloomed in the Central Botanical Garden of the National Academy of Sciences of Belarus in Minsk. The article also explains sakura’s symbolism in Japanese culture and notes that the bloom lasts less than a week.

titleZh: 中國研發可裝入殲-20/殲-35彈艙的新型隱身巡航飛彈
titleEn: China Develops New Stealth Cruise Missile Sized for J-20 and J-35 Bays
summary: 文章稱中國據報開發一款可裝入殲-20與殲-35內置彈艙的新型隱身巡航飛彈，具備亞音速長程打擊與紅外抑制設計，射程約1330公里，並被拿來對比美軍LRASM，強調其對西太平洋美國航母打擊群的威脅。
summaryZh: 文章稱中國據報開發新型隱身巡航飛彈，可由殲-20與殲-35內置彈艙攜帶，射程約1330公里，並以低可偵測設計、紅外抑制與亞音速飛行強化突防能力，對西太平洋美軍航母戰鬥群構成威脅。
summaryEn: The article says China is reportedly developing a stealth cruise missile small enough for J-20 and J-35 internal bays, with roughly 1,330 km range, subsonic cruise, and infrared suppression. It argues the weapon could complicate U.S. carrier defense in the western Pacific.

titleZh: 盧卡申科就湖南工廠悲劇事故向習近平致哀
titleEn: Lukashenko conveys condolences to Xi over tragic factory incident in Hunan
summary: 盧卡申科就中國湖南省一家工廠發生的悲劇性事件，向習近平致以慰問與哀悼。
summaryZh: 盧卡申科針對中國湖南省一座工廠發生的悲劇性事故，向習近平表達慰問與哀悼。
summaryEn: Lukashenko expressed condolences to Xi Jinping over a tragic incident at a factory in Hunan Province, China.

titleZh: 南韓開始量產自製戰機KF-21
titleEn: South Korea begins serial production of its KF-21 fighter jet
summary: 南韓於2026年開始量產自製戰機KF-21 Boramae，標誌其國防工業由研發邁向實戰部署。文章介紹了KF-21的開發歷程、Block 1到Block 3的分階段升級、國產化進展、武器與航電配置，以及面向波蘭、印尼等國的出口潛力。
summaryZh: 南韓在2026年啟動KF-21 Boramae戰機量產，象徵國防工業的重要升級。文章回顧該計畫從KF-X研發到原型測試與量產的進程，並說明其國產化、武器整合、出口前景與後續Block 2、Block 3升級路線。
summaryEn: South Korea has begun serial production of the KF-21 Boramae in 2026, marking a major step for its defense industry. The article reviews the KF-X program’s development, prototype testing, phased upgrades, localization efforts, weapons integration, and export prospects to partners such as Poland and Indonesia.
keywordTermsZh: 主動電子掃描陣列雷達

titleZh: 煙火工廠爆炸後　習近平要求全力投入救援
titleEn: Xi Jinping Calls for All-Out Rescue Efforts After Fireworks Factory Explosion
summary: 文章報導習近平在中國一座煙火工廠發生爆炸後，呼籲動員一切力量投入救援與善後工作。內容聚焦於事故應對與緊急救援。
summaryZh: 文章報導習近平在中國煙火工廠爆炸後，要求動員全部力量展開救援工作，重點在事故應急處置與救災。
summaryEn: The article says Xi Jinping called for all available forces to be mobilized for rescue work after an explosion at a fireworks factory in China, focusing on emergency response and relief efforts.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙火工廠爆炸釀逾20死、60餘傷
titleEn: Fireworks Factory Blast in Hunan, China Kills More Than 20 and Injures Over 60
summary: 中國湖南省瀏陽一座煙火製造廠發生爆炸，造成20多人死亡、60多人受傷。當局已疏散周邊居民並投入機器人與消防救援力量，習近平要求全力搜救、查明原因並追究責任，同時加強全國生產場所安全管理。
summaryZh: 中國湖南省瀏陽一座煙火工廠發生爆炸，造成20多人死亡、60多人受傷。現場持續進行救援，周邊居民已疏散。習近平要求全力救助傷者、查明事故原因，並強化全國生產安全管理。
summaryEn: An explosion at a fireworks factory in Liuyang, Hunan Province, China, killed more than 20 people and injured over 60. Rescue teams continue work at the site after evacuations were ordered. Xi Jinping called for full rescue efforts, a swift investigation, and tighter industrial safety controls nationwide.

titleZh: 中國湖南煙花廠爆炸已造成26死61傷
titleEn: Explosion at Fireworks Factory in China’s Hunan Kills 26, Injures 61
summary: U fabrici vatrometa u kineskoj provinciji Hunan dogodila se snažna eksplozija u kojoj je poginulo 26 ljudi, a 61 je povređena. Spasilačke operacije su uglavnom završene, a vlasti istražuju uzrok nesreće i postupanje odgovornih u kompaniji.
summaryZh: 中國湖南省一間煙花廠發生嚴重爆炸，造成26人死亡、61人受傷。當地救援工作大致結束，相關部門正調查事故原因，警方也已拘留公司責任人。
summaryEn: A powerful explosion at a fireworks factory in China’s Hunan province killed 26 people and injured 61. Rescue operations are largely complete, while authorities investigate the cause and have detained responsible company personnel.

titleZh: 梅朗雄稱：特朗普欲封鎖霍爾木茲海峽切斷中國石油供應，計畫已失敗
titleEn: Mélenchon Says Trump Sought to Block Hormuz to Cut Oil to China, but the Plan Failed
summary: 梅朗雄表示，特朗普与伊朗冲突的目的之一，是借封锁霍尔木兹海峡切断运往中国的石油，但这一计划已经失败。他还批评美国低估了对全球贸易与美元体系的依赖，认为关税和贸易施压难以奏效。
summaryZh: 梅朗雄指稱，特朗普與伊朗衝突的算計之一，是透過封鎖霍爾木茲海峽切斷流向中國的石油供應，但此計畫未能奏效。他同時批評美國對全球貿易與美元體系過度依賴，認為關稅與貿易施壓難以達成預期效果。
summaryEn: Mélenchon said Trump entered a conflict with Iran hoping to quickly block the Strait of Hormuz and cut off oil flowing to China, but that plan failed. He also argued the U.S. underestimates its dependence on global trade and the dollar, and that tariff pressure is unlikely to work.

titleZh: 深圳與香港路演後，“偉大石頭”園區新增中白慢病治療中心項目
titleEn: After Shenzhen and Hong Kong roadshow, Great Stone park adds China-Belarus chronic disease treatment project
summary: “偉大石頭”工業園在深圳與香港路演後，迎來新入駐企業“達昌格”登記為居民企業，將在中白合作框架下建立慢性病綜合預防與治療中心，並伴隨多項戰略協議簽署。
summaryZh: “偉大石頭”工業園在深圳和香港舉辦路演後，新登記一家企業作為園區居民，將設立中白慢性病綜合預防與治療中心，提供從診斷到個人化營養治療的服務，並同步促成多項合作協議。
summaryEn: After a roadshow in Shenzhen and Hong Kong, Great Stone industrial park registered a new resident company that will build a China-Belarus center for comprehensive prevention and treatment of chronic diseases, offering services from diagnosis to personalized nutritional therapy alongside new cooperation deals.

titleZh: 中國在霍爾木茲海峽的策略：為何航母與潛艦並非關鍵
titleEn: China’s Strategy in the Strait of Hormuz: Why Carriers and Submarines Are Not the Key
summary: 文章分析中國在霍爾木茲海峽危機中的做法，認為北京不依賴航母或潛艦，而是透過與伊朗的經濟與能源關係維持影響力。作者指出，中國持續購買伊朗石油，並以雙邊安排而非海軍介入來保護自身利益。
summaryZh: 文章認為，中國面對霍爾木茲海峽危機時，真正的籌碼不是派出海軍，而是與伊朗維持能源與經貿關係。北京持續進口伊朗原油，並避免任何會限制未來行動的承諾。
summaryEn: The article argues that China’s leverage in the Strait of Hormuz comes less from naval power than from its economic and energy ties with Iran. Beijing continues buying Iranian oil and avoids commitments that would constrain its future options.

titleZh: 中國的「門羅主義」：以台灣與南海為核心的區域軍事戰略
titleEn: China's Monroe Doctrine: A Regional Military Strategy Centered on Taiwan and the South China Sea
summary: The article argues that China is not building a global power-projection navy like the United States, but a regional force designed to deny access around its core interests, especially Taiwan and the South China Sea. It says Beijing's A2/AD strategy is cheaper and better suited to its geography than expeditionary warfare.
summaryZh: 文章主張，中國軍力的目標不是全球投射，而是以A2/AD、反艦飛彈與潛艦在台灣與南海周邊建立拒止能力，讓美國與區域對手難以介入。作者認為這是一種更符合地理與成本結構的區域霸權戰略。
summaryEn: The article argues that China's military is built not for global projection but for regional denial through A2/AD, anti-ship missiles, and submarines around Taiwan and the South China Sea. It presents this as a cost-effective strategy tailored to China's geography and interests.

titleZh: 中國法院裁定：企業不得因導入AI就解僱員工
titleEn: Chinese court rules companies cannot fire workers solely for adopting AI
summary: 中國杭州法院裁定，企業不能僅因導入人工智能就解僱員工。案件涉及一名質檢專家因工作被AI取代後，拒絕降薪調職而遭解僱，法院認定公司做法違法並支持員工索賠。
summaryZh: 中國杭州法院裁定，企業不能僅因以AI取代員工就解僱人員。涉案員工因工作被AI系統接手後遭降薪調職並被解僱，法院認定公司違法並判賠。
summaryEn: A court in Hangzhou ruled that companies cannot fire workers merely because AI replaces their jobs. In the case, an employee was offered a lower-paid reassignment after automation and was later dismissed; the court sided with the worker and awarded compensation.

titleZh: 中國痛批賴清德訪問史瓦帝尼，重申一中原則
titleEn: China lashes out at Lai Ching-te's visit to Eswatini, reiterates One China stance
summary: 中國強烈批評台灣領導人賴清德訪問史瓦帝尼，稱其為「可笑」且是台獨分離主義的又一例證。報導指出，賴清德此行是上任後第二次出訪，台北則稱此行延後與中國有關。北京重申一中原則，並要求史瓦帝尼等國停止支持台獨。
summaryZh: 中國譴責台灣領導人賴清德訪問史瓦帝尼，稱其為「可笑」的台獨表演。報導指出，此行在多國撤回空域許可後延後，台北將延誤歸因於中國。北京重申一中原則，並敦促史瓦帝尼等國不要支持台灣獨立。
summaryEn: China condemned Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te's visit to Eswatini as a ridiculous display of separatism. The trip was delayed after several countries withdrew overflight permissions, which Taipei linked to Chinese pressure. Beijing reiterated the One China principle and urged Eswatini not to support Taiwan independence.

titleZh: 靜默的大國博弈：中國避免與美國正面衝突，但代價可能巨大
titleEn: The Quiet Great-Power Contest: China Avoids Direct Conflict with the U.S., but the Cost Could Be Huge
summary: 文章分析中國在當前大國競爭中的策略，認為北京傾向避免與美國直接衝突，而是透過經濟擴張、外交周旋與維持國內穩定來累積長期優勢。同時也指出中國對外部供應與市場依賴帶來的脆弱性。
summaryZh: 文章認為中國在2026年的國際緊張局勢中採取克制路線，避免與美國正面對抗，轉而強調內部穩定、經濟增長與長期戰略布局。不過，文章也提醒中國對外部能源與全球供應鏈的依賴，可能在危機中放大風險。
summaryEn: The article argues that China is responding to 2026 tensions with restraint, avoiding direct confrontation with the United States and prioritizing internal stability, economic growth, and long-term positioning. It also warns that China’s dependence on external energy and global supply chains leaves it vulnerable in a crisis.

titleZh: 中國接任聯合國安理會輪值主席　五月聚焦中東、烏克蘭、非洲與波黑議題
titleEn: China Takes UN Security Council Chair in May, with Debates on the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa and Bosnia
summary: China will chair the UN Security Council in May and lead several debates on global security, including the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and North Korea. The agenda also includes meetings on civilian protection, sanctions, Libya, Syria, Lebanon, and other crises.
summaryZh: 中國將在五月擔任聯合國安理會輪值主席，主導多場涉及全球安全的辯論，議題涵蓋中東、烏克蘭、非洲、波黑與北韓等。會期內也將討論平民保護、利比亞制裁、敘利亞、人道議題與黎巴嫩情勢。
summaryEn: China will chair the UN Security Council in May and oversee multiple debates on global security, covering the Middle East, Ukraine, Africa, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and North Korea. The month also includes sessions on civilian protection, Libya sanctions, Syria, Lebanon, and humanitarian issues.

titleZh: 特朗普稱訪華將很順利　預計會晤習近平
titleEn: Trump Says His Upcoming China Visit Will Be Great, Plans to Meet Xi
summary: 特朗普表示即将于5月14日至15日访问中国，并预计与习近平会面。他称此次访华“会很出色”，并提到自己可能出席6月在法国举行的G7峰会。这将是他自2025年1月重返白宫后的首次访华。
summaryZh: 特朗普表示將於5月14日至15日訪問中國，並預計與中國國家主席習近平會面。他稱此次訪華將會很出色，並提到自己可能出席6月在法國舉行的G7峰會。這將是他自2025年1月重返白宮後首次訪華。
summaryEn: Trump said he expects his May 14-15 visit to China to go well and said he will likely meet Chinese President Xi Jinping. He also noted he may attend the G7 summit in France in mid-June. The trip would be his first to China since returning to the White House in January 2025.

titleZh: 台灣發生5.8級地震，暫無災損報告
titleEn: Magnitude 5.8 Earthquake Strikes Taiwan, No Damage Reported
summary: Taiwan was hit by a magnitude 5.8 earthquake, with the epicenter reported 97 km deep and located near Taipei and Keelung. No damage has been reported so far.
summaryZh: 台灣發生5.8級地震，震源深度約97公里，震央位於台北與基隆附近。報導稱目前尚未接獲任何損害通報。
summaryEn: A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Taiwan at a depth of about 97 km, with the epicenter near Taipei and Keelung. No damage has been reported so far.

titleZh: 北韓駐聯大使批美韓軍演釀緊張　中日韓美在安理會交鋒
titleEn: North Korea Envoy Slams U.S.-South Korea Drills as China, Japan, and South Korea Clash at the UN
summary: At a UN Security Council meeting on North Korea, diplomats from North Korea, South Korea, Japan, China, Russia, France and the United States clashed over missile launches, sanctions, and military cooperation. South Korea warned that Pyongyang's nuclear and missile programs keep escalating, while China urged the U.S. to stop provocative drills.
summaryZh: 聯合國安理會討論北韓問題時，各方圍繞核武、飛彈試射、制裁與俄朝軍事合作激烈交鋒。南韓警告平壤持續升級威脅；中國則敦促美國停止挑釁性軍演，認為應為僵局負責。
summaryEn: At a UN Security Council session on North Korea, delegates argued over nuclear and missile programs, sanctions, and Russia-North Korea military ties. South Korea warned that Pyongyang continues to escalate, while China urged the U.S. to stop provocative military drills.

titleZh: 分析稱美軍 F-22 對華威懾效果受限，南海與呂宋海峽部署引關注
titleEn: Analysis: U.S. F-22 Effectiveness Against China Questioned as South China Sea Patrols Draw Attention
summary: 文章分析美军F-22在菲律宾巴萨基地周边与南海、吕宋海峡的行动，指出这类部署延伸了对中国的军事施压。文中也提到“Cope Thunder 26-1”演习展示了美菲联合作战与前沿基地起降能力，但对轻型战机在高强度冲突中的适用性提出质疑。
summaryZh: 文章指出，美軍F-22自菲律賓巴薩基地出動，靠近南海與呂宋海峽，藉此把軍事壓力延伸到第一島鏈。文中援引“Cope Thunder 26-1”演習，稱美菲可提升聯合作戰與前沿部署能力，但也質疑相關戰機在高強度衝突中的效能。
summaryEn: The article says U.S. F-22s operating from Basa Air Base in the Philippines flew near the South China Sea and Luzon Strait, extending military pressure across the first island chain. It cites Cope Thunder 26-1 as proof of U.S.-Philippine integration, while questioning whether such fighters are effective in a high-intensity conflict with China.

titleZh: 王毅：在習近平與特朗普領導下 中美關係保持穩定
titleEn: Wang Yi Says China-U.S. Ties Remain Stable Under Xi and Trump
summary: 王毅與美國副總統通話，稱在習近平與特朗普的戰略引領下，中美關係總體保持穩定。雙方都強調維持溝通、管控分歧與推動高層互動；王毅並指出台灣問題是中國核心利益與中美關係最敏感點。
summaryZh: 王毅與美國副總統通話時表示，在習近平與特朗普的戰略引領下，中美關係總體保持穩定。雙方同意維持高層溝通、管控分歧並尋求戰略穩定；王毅同時強調台灣問題是中國核心利益。
summaryEn: Wang Yi said in a call with the U.S. vice president that China-U.S. relations have remained broadly stable under the strategic guidance of Xi Jinping and Donald Trump. Both sides emphasized communication, managing differences, and strategic stability, while Wang highlighted Taiwan as a core Chinese interest.

titleZh: 高市早苗促伊朗保障荷姆茲海峽航行安全
titleEn: Japan Urges Iran to Guarantee Safe Passage Through the Strait of Hormuz
summary: 日本首相高市早苗與伊朗總統佩澤希齊揚通話，要求德黑蘭盡快確保各國船隻能安全通過荷姆茲海峽。她並表示，日本希望美伊恢復談判。伊朗方面則稱，美國與以色列應為中東局勢負責。
summaryZh: 日本首相高市早苗與伊朗總統通話，要求伊朗盡快確保各國船隻安全通過荷姆茲海峽，並呼籲美伊恢復談判。日本強調將持續透過外交管道維持溝通。
summaryEn: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi urged Iran to guarantee safe passage for ships through the Strait of Hormuz during a phone call with President Masoud Pezeshkian. She also called for renewed U.S.-Iran talks, while Iran blamed the U.S. and Israel for regional insecurity.

titleZh: 美國高超音速武器「Dark Eagle」：針對中國與俄羅斯的震懾利器
titleEn: America’s Dark Eagle Hypersonic Weapon: A Deterrent Built Against China and Russia
summary: 文章介绍美国高超音速武器“Dark Eagle”的研发现状、作战特点与潜在部署设想，强调其可用于深度打击和突破防空体系。文中同时指出，该系统的现代化推进与中国、俄罗斯的高超音速进展有关。
summaryZh: 文章介紹美國高超音速武器「Dark Eagle」的能力、研發背景與成本，並指出其開發是為回應中國與俄羅斯的高超音速進展。文中還談到美方可能在中東部署該武器以威懾伊朗。
summaryEn: The article describes the U.S. hypersonic weapon Dark Eagle, its development, capabilities, and cost, noting that its modernization was driven in part by advances from China and Russia. It also says the system could be deployed in the Middle East to deter Iran.

titleZh: 台灣議題再度升溫：北京指責東京在印太推動陣營對抗
titleEn: Taiwan Back in the Spotlight as Beijing Accuses Tokyo of Fueling Bloc Politics in the Indo-Pacific
summary: Kina je optužila Japan da pod izgovorom slobodnog i otvorenog Indo-Pacifika gradi zatvorene bezbednosne blokove u regionu. Povod su najave posete premijerke Sanae Takaiči Vijetnamu i Australiji, kao i sve oštrije kinesko-japanske tenzije oko Tajvana i japanske bezbednosne politike.
summaryZh: 中國指責日本以「自由開放的印太」為名，實際上在推動陣營對抗與排他性安全安排。報導指出，雙方緊張升高的核心仍是台灣議題，以及日本對台海安全與自身國安關聯的更強硬表述。
summaryEn: China accused Japan of using the “free and open Indo-Pacific” concept to promote bloc confrontation and exclusive security groupings. The dispute comes amid worsening tensions over Taiwan, with Japan increasingly linking Taiwan Strait stability to its own national security.
